annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: A life hangs on this, maybe mine, maybe one of the other five.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll go to their family myself and tell them exactly how it went down

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Part of me wants to step forward and part of me wants to hold back
annotations.pda_responsibility: If my stalling costs even a minute, I'll own that.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll sit down with everyone who was on that island and explain

annotations.sys_rule_justification: a call none of us has earned the right to make alone
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Let's draw straws, fast, so it's fair and nobody gets pressured.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll help pay toward whatever they need
I'll write down everything I remember about whoever stayed and hand it to their family

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe someone has a reason I can't see.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll find their family and offer whatever help I can
I'll be the one who tells the rescuers and the families the truth
annotations.pda_responsibility: even if it makes me look bad

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: This is the hardest question anyone's ever handed me
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll set up a fund in their name

annotations.pda_responsibility: I'm stalling, and I'll say so plainly.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll apologize face to face to anyone I pushed during the argument
I'll give a full account of everything that happened here

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: a choice this heavy should belong to all six of us
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help cover whatever costs they face
annotations.pda_responsibility: tell them honestly that I didn't step up
